```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
offenses <- read_csv(here('offense_segment.csv'))
batches <- read_csv(here('nibrs_batch_header_1991_2024.csv')) %>% 
  filter(grepl('200[0-5]', year))
```

```{r}
cities = c('akron', 'ames', 'ann arbor', 'athens', 'austin', 
            'blacksburg', 'boise', 'clemson', 'colorado springs', 
            'columbia', 'columbus', 'denton', 'east lansing', 
            'fayetteville', 'huntington', 'iowa city', 'jonesboro',
            'kalamazoo', 'lawrence', 'logan', 'lubbock', 'morgantown', 
            'moscow', 'mount pleasant', 'murfreesboro', 'provo')

batches_filtered <- batches %>% 
  filter(city_name %in% cities)

oris_per_university = tribble(
  ~university, ~city_name, ~ori,
  'the university of akron', 'akron', 'OH0772800',
  'iowa state university', 'ames', 'IA0850100',
  'the university of michigan', 'ann arbor', 'MI8190300',
  'ohio university', 'athens', 'OH0050100',
  'the university of texas at austin', 'austin', 'TX2270500',
  'virginia polytechnic institute and state university', 'blacksburg', 'VA0600100',
  'boise state university', 'boise', 'ID0010100',
  'clemson university', 'clemson', 'SC0390600', 
  'united states air force academy', 'colorado springs', 'CO0210100',
  'the university of south carolina', 'columbia', 'SC0400600',
  'the ohio state university', 'columbus', 'OH0252700',
  'the university of north texas', 'denton', 'TX0611100',
  'michigan state university', 'east lansing', 'MI3336400',
  'university of arkansas', 'fayetteville', 'AR0720400',
  'marshall university', 'huntington', 'WV0060200',
  'the university of iowa', 'iowa city', 'IA0520400',
  'arkansas state university', 'jonesboro', 'AR0160500',
  'western michigan university', 'kalamazoo', 'MI3949900',
  'the university of kansas', 'lawrence', 'KS0230100',
  'utah state university', 'logan', 'UT0031600',
  'texas tech university', 'lubbock', 'TX1520600',
  'west virginia university', 'morgantown', 'WV0310100',
  'the university of idaho', 'moscow', 'ID0290500', 
  'eastern michigan university', 'mount pleasant', 'MI3759900',
  'middle tennessee state university', 'murfreesboro', 'TN0750100',
  'brigham young university', 'provo', 'UT0250600'
)

batches_filtered <- oris_per_university %>% 
  left_join(batches_filtered, by=c('ori', 'city_name'))

```

```{r}
offenses_filtered <- batches_filtered %>% 
  left_join(offenses) %>% 
  drop_na(year)

# All the assault cases
offenses_filtered %>% 
  filter(grepl('assault', ucr_offense_code)) %>% 
  select(ucr_offense_code) %>% 
  unique()

# All the vandalism cases
offenses_filtered %>% 
  filter(grepl('vandalism', ucr_offense_code)) %>% 
  select(ucr_offense_code) %>% 
  unique()



```
